title: Deeper/broader cross-implementation issue refresh and GeoData version-axis resolution
scope: Primary-source issue/fix refresh across ACadSharp, LibreDWG, and ezdxf, reconciled with the authoritative local ODA DWG specification and current libdxfrw source/tests. Research-only plan update.

sources.observation: Section 20.4.78 distinguishes GeoData object-version body formats (1=AutoCAD 2009, 2=2010, 3=2013 with 2010 body) from the Civil-tail release gate. It says the tail follows the mesh arrays for DWG R21 or lower and separately says AutoCAD 2010 always writes it. The local helper's AC1021/AC1024 positive and AC1027/AC1032 negative matrix matches this rule.

The mutable source places its CIVIL3D_DATA block after both main-body version branches and the mesh arrays, gated by UNTIL (R_2007); its class_version comment does not make the tail itself class-version-gated. This is corroborating implementation evidence only; ODA remains authoritative.

The report describes class-version-1 GeoData Civil-tail loss in two private drawings and a different field layout, but does not disclose source or target DWG magic, sample hashes, or literal bytes. It cannot resolve whether the observed files are AC1021, the AC1024 AutoCAD-2010 exception, or a later profile.

An AC1032 DWG with TextFrame-only MTEXT is reported rejected by AutoCAD 2025, while value 17 and AC1027 reportedly open. The author reports MTEXT-object byte identity after a correction while whole-file rejection remains; proposed missing-style causes are explicitly unproven.

The issue identifies ACadSharp NuGet 3.8.0 and links a DWG/DXF archive, but publishes no bad handle, ordered arrays, exact GDAL diagnostic/options, or independent expected curve. Web retrieval returned a cache miss; the attachment was not inspected or included in the repository.

sources.project: Autodesk SPLINE reference and GDAL DXF route
sources.observation: The published SPLINE field contract supports exact-array review; GDAL is a downstream projection/tessellation route, not an independent NURBS geometry oracle.

The synthetic report distinguishes $DWGCODEPAGE declaration from actual CP949 payload bytes. Local tests already assert canonical ANSI_949, exact CP949 bytes, semantic text and a following-text sentinel.

Peer reports describe ASCII DXF CR framing corruption and allocator-dependent uninitialized tail data in a C string quoting helper. Local PAR-136 and existing text tests have different implementation mechanisms and keep field-specific CR/LF, raw-carrier, Binary-DXF, and transactional rules.

sources.project: ezdxf Binary-DXF proxy issue and merged fix
sources.observation: The issue was closed by PR #1418, merged as c87c87e on 2026-10-02. The patch passes raw binary chunks through the writer protocol. PR discussion reports focused validation but not a full suite; a released package containing the merge was not established.

local_audit: src/drw_objects.cpp: hasGeoDataCivilTail selects AC1021 and AC1024; parseDwg and encodeDwg share the target-version predicate.

tests/dwg_object_vectors_tests.cpp: generated vectors currently pair AC1021/object-version-1 with a tail, AC1024/object-version-2 with a tail, AC1027/object-version-2/3 without a tail, and AC1032/object-version-2 without a tail. The existing builder can author additional target/object-version combinations in memory.
tests/dwg_object_vectors_tests.cpp already checks body-end and deferred-handle sentinels, false-first-bit tail consumption, truncation refusal, and retry.
Local MTEXT frame-flag vectors cover 0/16/17 under AC1027/AC1032; they do not claim whole-file native writer acceptance.
Local CP949, Binary-DXF proxy-graphic, ASCII semantic-control-string, and generated SPLINE owners already cover the corresponding peer failure classes at their stated scope.
decisions: Preserve PAR-119/7BP's ODA-backed target-release gate; do not switch to class-version selection from ACadSharp #1261 or LibreDWG's source notation.

Add a focused generated readiness pair only: AC1024/object-version-1 with the Civil tail, and AC1027/object-version-1 without it. Assert the body schema, tail presence, cursor/body boundary, and handle sentinel independently.
Keep ACadSharp #1297 as a whole-file native DWG-writer report with an unproven cause; do not expand local DWG-writer scope or reinterpret MTEXT flags.

Keep ACadSharp #1299 as a trigger-only SPLINE lead. If needed during a future SPLINE change, inspect a hash-pinned copy in disposable scratch and compare exact arrays plus independently evaluated curve points; never commit the archive as a fixture.
Keep peer text and codepage reports on existing PAR-05/7AR owners. Do not port implementation-specific C fixes or change CR/LF/opaque-carrier behavior from peer reports.
Record ezdxf #1412 as fixed on current master by #1418, but do not infer the fix is in a released package or use it as a libdxfrw support result.
Add no new finding or top-level subplan; no production code, test, fixture, dependency, peer/native run, validation cadence, queue order, or support claim changes.
Keep J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.

plan_effect.change: Focused test-readiness refinement for object-version-1 combinations across the AC1024 exception and AC1027 no-tail target; fresh issue-to-owner crosswalk
